description: Shrink or extend the size of each file to the specified size.

option.name: --io-blocks
tip: treat SIZE as the number of I/O blocks of the file rather than bytes (NOT IMPLEMENTED)

option.name: --no-create
tip: do not create files that do not exist

option.name: --reference
tip: base the size of each file on the size of RFILE

option.name: --size
tip: set or adjust the size of each file according to SIZE, which is in bytes unless --io-blocks is specified
